CustomField.label: Approval Levels
CustomField.description:
★R9 How many levels this invitee's chain has, stamped by ApprovalChainService at submit time alongside the Approver_N__c fields. Two invitees on the same event routinely differ: one belongs to a customer whose Account Owner is a Regional Head and needs one signature, another needs three.
Read with Current_Level__c it gives the approver and the AM the same one-line answer — "level 2 of 3" — that the Approval History would otherwise have to be opened for. Blank on a Draft row.
